name: NHS & respiratory
summary: UKHSA 19 Nov: flu admissions up to 4.68 per 100,000, low level and rising; RSV rising; COVID-19 stable
state: UKHSA's weekly data of 19 Nov, covering 9–15 Nov, put influenza hospital admissions at 4.68 per 100,000, up from 3.76, with activity still at low levels and positivity up to 11.4% from 8.3% (UKHSA). RSV admissions rose to 1.66 per 100,000 and COVID-19 was stable at 2.22. Flu is above baseline and rising but not at high levels, and no widespread NHS critical incidents were found, so Watch is kept.
for_you: Flu is rising earlier in the season. UKHSA and the NHS advise eligible people to get their flu and COVID-19 vaccines; follow NHS 111 guidance on when to seek care and stay home when unwell where possible.
rubric_hit: Watch: flu admissions 4.68 per 100,000 (wk 46), above baseline and rising; not at high level
